name: Porcelain vs Ceramic Tile: Which Belongs in a Renton Home
title-tag: Porcelain vs Ceramic Tile: A Renton, WA Installer's Guide
meta-description: Porcelain vs ceramic tile, honestly: what the 0.5% absorption line means, which rooms in a Renton home need which, and why the installer matters more.
post-summary: October 13, 2026 · Porcelain is just denser ceramic — fired until it absorbs almost no water — and that one number decides where each belongs: porcelain on floors, wet rooms and anything outdoors; ceramic on walls and backsplashes. The honest part the showroom skips: the installer matters more than the material, and mid-grade tile set right outlasts premium tile set wrong.
